whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a rustflag that changes code generation for the whole workspace.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a rustflag that changes code generation for the whole workspace.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm .cargo/config.toml no longer carries a rustflag that changes code generation for the whole workspace.
